description: This bar chart illustrates the % point difference for two models, XLM-R and layer, across 12 categories labeled “concat” from 0 to 12. The horizontal axis represents the “concat” categories, labeled 0 through 12 in ascending order, and appears to be categorical. The vertical axis represents the “% point difference”, with a linear scale ranging from -10 to 0, with tick labels at -2 point intervals. The chart contains two sets of bars, one for XLM-R and one for layer. The XLM-R bars are light blue, and their heights decrease from approximately -0.4 at concat 0 to approximately -2.2 at concat 1, then remain relatively consistent around -2.3 for concats 2 through 11, before increasing to -1.4 at concat 12. The layer bars are dark blue, and their heights decrease from approximately 2.4 at concat 0 to approximately -5.4 at concat 4, then increase to -1.8 at concat 12. The bars are arranged side-by-side for each “concat” category, allowing for a visual comparison of the % point difference between the two models. No bars are visually emphasized, and the bars are ordered by ascending “concat” value.
